title: Condensation terminology, conditional categorical-neutrality, and supporting evidence
html:
Remark. Condensation terminology, conditional categorical-neutrality, and supporting evidence

Terminology: "condensation"

The vanishing E_\infty^{p, >0}(n) = 0 dictates that every higher descent residue collapses onto the diagonal. There are no off-diagonal jet-tower contributions at saturated n. The shell condenses into a single graded piece. For n \notin \mathfrak{M} the off-diagonal pieces survive. They provide the algebraic content of non-saturation (residual capacity to absorb crossing energy).

The phenomenology this picks up is standard. At n \in \mathfrak{M} the binding-energy curve flattens, the next nucleon adds nearly-zero binding, and the shell is mathematically "full". The refactor identifies this directly in the spectral sequence, rather than via shell-model fitting.

Conditional content via the categorical-neutrality conjecture

Conditional on prop:categorical-neutrality-saturated-shells, the full-twist \Delta_n^2 acts as the identity on \Phi_n at n \in \mathfrak{M}. The categorical neutrality forces the Wedderburn support of \Phi_n onto self-conjugate partitions. Pairing this with Yekutieli rigidity [yekutieli2010], the descent involution \hat\tau inherits the corresponding self-conjugacy on A_n, and the BB stratification becomes self-dual: the strata above the E_2 collapse line cancel pairwise. The conjectured E_\infty^{p, >0}(n) = 0 forms the algebraic-geometry crystallisation of this cancellation.

This conditional structure justifies authoring both conjectures together. The categorical conjecture forms the Hecke-side content; the homological conjecture forms its brane-tower-side image under Yekutieli rigidity. A proof of either implies the other under the substrate axioms.

Relation to the Hoefsmit / matrix-evaluation programme

Numerical verification at k = 3, \dots, 10 (conj:magic-numbers-from-q) empirically confirms E_\infty^{p, >0}(n) = 0 at n = 2, 8, 20 via direct computation of descent residues from Hoefsmit matrices. The combinatorial blow-up at k \geq 12 blocks the matrix-evaluation approach. The homological framework analytically bypasses this barrier by replacing per-partition matrix computation with spectral-sequence arithmetic (rem:k12-barrier-bypass).

Operator-level support (clarification)

The "Wedderburn support of \Phi_n onto self-conjugate partitions" in §"Conditional content" above describes operator-level support. \Phi_n has zero matrix entries on non-self-conjugate isotypical components, but the operator on the self-conjugate components is generically non-trivial. It is not the Plancherel-weighted character sum \sum_{\lambda = \lambda'} w_\lambda \chi^\lambda, which vanishes identically at certain atomic-braid cycle types. The E_\infty^{p, >0}(n) = 0 collapse condition stated above is precisely operator-level (page collapse on the associated graded algebra). It remains consistent with this reading.

Discussion

This remains conjectural. The supporting evidence comprises:

  1. Numerical verification at n \in \{2, 8, 20\} via the matrix-evaluation programme.
  2. Conditional equivalence with prop:categorical-neutrality-saturated-shells under Yekutieli rigidity (the Hecke-side conjecture is stated independently).
  3. Phenomenological agreement: the seven values \{2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126\} form the only nucleon counts at which the experimental binding curve exhibits a discontinuous first-derivative drop (the empirical signature of shell closure).

The downstream cone affects the higher-magic-number predictions n \in \{50, 82, 126\} where matrix evaluation remains unavailable. Any result quoting these higher-magic-number predictions therefore depends on this conjecture, and stays conjectural until either the conjecture is proved or the prediction is demoted to a numerical empirical claim.
